in_arabic.name: Berka
in_arabic.long_meaning: Berka هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. A name derived from the Turkish word for 'birch tree', symbolizing strength, resilience, and renewal. In Arabic, Berka can also be derived from the word 'birraka', meaning 'precious gift from God'.
